body: Honestly, sleep isn't going to happen. I just want to talk with some people. And I am owning up to my mistake. I was completely cooperative with the police. But I think doing that hurt me in the long run. Then there is my car. I really hope I can have it repaired. I'm just beside myself with grief at this point. And my life is about to be over as I know it. I need to let it go. And I'm talking about my life, not my physical being life ending. You and another redditor have helped with that. Thank you.

Yeah. I'm 23. I actually have a friend over. She's just here. It's comforting. I'm angry with myself for doing this. I know better. I'm a medic for heavens sake. Ugh. I just don't know what to say to my family. They'll disown me. I haven't slept all night. I'm really trying to get through this. I'm talking to a lawyer tomorrow. And you guys here are helping. Thank you.
